facts.fact: 叙述者承认读者可能以为他恨 CIA，并当场否认。
facts.anchor: By now you might think I hate CIA, nuncle, but if you did you’d be wrong. I don’t hate CIA, not at all.

facts.fact: 他说自己恨的是 CIA 这个机构把自己变成的样子。
facts.anchor: I just hate what the Agency has allowed herself to become.

facts.fact: 他给出理由：之所以恨它变成这样，是因为他爱美国。
facts.anchor: the reason I hate what the Agency has allowed herself to become is because I love the United States of America

facts.fact: 他列举所爱：阵亡将士纪念日「Rolling Thunder」游行中五十万辆摩托车驶过国家档案馆。
facts.anchor: 500,000 motorcycles cruise past the National Archives during the annual Memorial Day “Rolling Thunder” parade

facts.fact: 他把历经艰险、合法入境的移民称为重燃美国梦的人，并以埃塞俄比亚为例。
facts.anchor: who pass through hell and high water to get here legally from someplace else like Ethiopia

facts.fact: 他设想 9/11 袭击者若把热核武器藏在客机内，后果会如何。
facts.anchor: our attackers had gotten their hands on airliners with thermonuclear weapons hidden inside

facts.fact: 他对不同意「需要情报机构」的读者发出半开玩笑的威胁：我们有你的 GPS 坐标。
facts.anchor: And we have your GPS coordinates, for when it comes time to find, fix, and finish you using the disposition matrix and a double tap.

facts.fact: 他断言今天的 CIA 是慢动作列车事故与国家安全噩梦。
facts.anchor: today’s CIA is a slow-motion train wreck and national security nightmare
